_about: Deterministic source rules of the evidence admission gate (src/source_authority.py). source_authority says WHO publishes a source (government, manufacturer, importer, press office, aggregator, marketplace, publisher); it never says that a source describes the exact target variant: authority and variant identity are separate dimensions (src/document_binding.py). Domains match the host or any subdomain. Brand slugs match the registrable domain label (toyota.co.uk, toyota-europe.com); an official domain of ANOTHER brand is not official for the target. market_by_tld / market_by_registrable_hint / path locales derive the market a source describes; Hebrew-language text is the IL market. Editing this file changes classification with no code change. A brand slug is official only as the whole registrable label or with a listed suffix (toyota-europe), never as a prefix of another name (toyota-forum). Registrable labels follow a generic second-level rule (co / com / org ... under a two-letter TLD). A path locale counts only as language-country (/en-gb/). importer_slugs (a subset of slugs): the labels the brand's target-market importer uses; with importer_tlds they give the importer domains search_official_domains defaults to (src/tools/search.importer_domains: heyxpeng x il -> heyxpeng.co.il).

il_version_sites._about: PR #44 (P2): Israeli publisher / aggregator sites that publish ONE page per technical version (title / H1 / URL slug name the version, spec rows state its engine). src/il_version_pages.py resolves the target's version page on these sites before the agentic acquisition: at most `max_searches` site-restricted searches in total (built from `search_templates`, placeholders {domain} {make_he} {make_en} {model} {year} {engine_l} {hp}; an empty placeholder is dropped), version links (`version_url_patterns`) collected from a fetched model / price-list page of the same site, at most `max_fetches` candidate URLs, robots.txt respected, at most one request per `min_interval_s` per domain. A fetched page counts only through the deterministic verdict il_version_pages.version_page_verdict (one version; year, displacement, drivetrain, propulsion, body and power match). `version_url_patterns` (PR #45, R1): regular expressions over the decoded, lower-case URL path of the site's version pages (cartube: a version slug under make / model; icar: /versionNNN/; auto.co.il: /cars/<make>/<model>/<year>/<id>/). Only a search result or a listing link matching one is a candidate, ranked by its slug overlap with the target (engine litres, power, designation, drivetrain, year); a site's home page is never fetched and any other page of the site is fetched only to collect version links. A `site:` search that yields nothing useful is retried once with the search backend's domain filter (no `site:` prefix) inside the max_searches budget. Every search result and candidate decision is logged in the il_version_pages event. Data only: adding a site is a JSON edit. `identity_row_terms`: the spec-row labels a version page's identity is read from (with the title, H1 and URL slug). PR #47 (A1 / A3): templates may name the target's Hebrew model ({model_he}), Latin model ({model_en}) and body market names ({body_he} / {body_en}, identity vocabulary `body_market_names`); a site's own `search_templates` replace the global ones for that site. carzone.co.il: `trim_url_patterns` + `trim_query_param` mark a trim page (/<Make>/<Model>/<Sub>?/<year>?trim=<slug>; the slug is read with `trim_slug`), `version_url_patterns` its compare page (/<Make>/<Model>/<Sub>?/<year>/compare, read with `compare_table`: one column per version, header row `trim_row_labels`, empty cells `empty_cells`). A trim page URL is a candidate only when a search result or a fetched carzone page offered it (never built). A site with `single_version_pages: false` (carzone) never gets the single-version page verdict: its trim and compare pages are judged by src/il_trim_pages.py.
